lord_placement.text: Venus is in the 4th house (Sukha bhav) in Scorpio. This house covers mother, home, property, vehicles, inner peace, schooling. It is a kendra (angle: 1/4/7/10) – planets here act strongly and visibly. Venus is in a neutral sign – average results. For your Leo ascendant it rules houses 3 & 10 (courage; career), so those matters are carried into the 4th house. It is a functional malefic for this ascendant (rules 3/6/8/11). Aspected by Saturn, Rahu. It aspects house 10. Nakshatra Jyeshtha (pada 1, ruled by Mercury).
